credits.title: Ebenezer
credits.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

credits.title: Medora: Empress of the Badlands
credits.overview: In 1883 Dakota Territory, the Marquis de Mores and wife Medora arrive to build a home, town, and meat empire, facing hostility from ranchers, beef trusts, and violent locals determined to drive them out.

credits.title: Return to Silent Hill
credits.overview: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.

credits.title: Boys from County Hell
credits.overview: A crew of hardy road workers, led by a bickering Father and Son, must survive the night when they accidentally awaken an ancient Irish vampire.

credits.title: Keratin
credits.overview: An isolated man's ritualistic pursuit of creation in the heart of a dark, dense forest.

credits.title: In the Trap
credits.overview: Philip, a solitary proof reader, is trapped in his apartment, too afraid to leave and tortured by an unknown evil force that has kept him prisoner for the last two years.

credits.title: The Jack in the Box
credits.overview: When a vintage Jack-in-the-box is un-earthed and opened, it's new owners soon have reason to believe the creepy clown doll within has a life of its own.

credits.title: Winter Memories
credits.overview: Lying on his deathbed, a grandfather tells one last tale to his grandson—the story about how he met his grandmother. When a monster appears, a heartbreaking secret comes to light that changes the family forever.

credits.title: Biopunk
credits.overview: The year is 2054, and humanity’s prospects are very bleak in the wake of a devastating virus. London’s become an unstable wasteland of junk peddlers and wild-eyed zealots, but one tough, determined woman keeps it together for her much younger brother—until he’s spirited away by an unknown foe.

credits.title: Marrowbone
credits.overview: A young man and his three younger siblings are plagued by a sinister presence in the sprawling manor in which they live.

credits.title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
credits.overview: A rogue band of resistance fighters unite for a mission to steal the Death Star plans and bring a new hope to the galaxy.

credits.title: Lamb's Damnation
credits.overview: A man seeks immediate refuge in a church in the dead of night, seeking to confront his gruesome tormentor and put an end to the immense pain they both feel.

credits.title: Howl
credits.overview: When passengers on a train are attacked by a creature, they must band together in order to survive until morning.

credits.title: Interlude
credits.overview: An inventor on the brink of fulfilling his life's work finally faces the truth behind the machine he is building.
